messages:
marta: Heads up — after PTQ (int8 symmetric) on the reranker we're seeing NDCG@10 drop across webqa-2025 dev/prod holdouts.
stats: fp16: 0.412 -> ptq-int8: 0.389 (delta -0.023). MRR@10: 0.287 -> 0.283
run: ./eval/rerank_eval.py --model rerank-fp16 -> rerank-ptq-v2 --dataset webqa-2025 --split dev

ajay: Is the model or the evaluation pipeline changed? Any candidate generation/pruning changes?

marta: The only infra change I know is candidate-pruning now set to top_k=100 (was 200) in the new routing config earlier today. Also we switched HTML stripping to pre-tokenize stage in the pipeline.

liam: Interesting — dropping top_k can remove hard negatives, that could affect ndcg more than mrr. Can you repro by running ptq with top_k=200?

eva: Also check whitespace/normalized tokens: moving HTML-strip earlier added an extra collapse step. Diff:
```
- tokens = tokenize(html_strip(text))
+ tokens = tokenize(collapse_ws(html_strip(text)))
```
Could change token boundaries for long docs.

marta: Re-ran quick eval comparing four configs:
```
fp16 top_k=200 : ndcg@10 0.412
fp16 top_k=100 : ndcg@10 0.407
ptq  top_k=200 : ndcg@10 0.403
ptq  top_k=100 : ndcg@10 0.389
```
So looks like pruning explains ~0.005 and PTQ ~0.009; combined -> ~0.023

ajay: Nice ablation. Next steps: (1) revert pruning to 200 in canary, (2) run ptq with old formatting, (3) run per-query delta to see which queries dropped.

liam: I'll revert pruning in canary now, will kick off ptq-run with old formatting flag `--legacy-formatting` and post results in this thread.

eval-bot: scheduled job 2319 started: rerank-ptq-v2 vs fp16 ablation on webqa-2025 (canary)

marta: Pausing rollout until we confirm. If pruning change is the main culprit we can roll back infra change quickly. Thanks!

ajay: +1

liam: quick update — job 2319 done, ndcg@10:
fp16 top_k=200 0.412 -> ptq top_k=200 0.405
ptq top_k=100 0.389 (matches earlier)
I'll upload per-query diff CSV to s3://redwood-evals/csvs/2319-delta.csv

marta: Great, will dig into per-query drops (likely long-tail doc length/HTML-heavy queries). Will ping when I have slices.

eva: if formatting is the issue we should add a consistency check in the eval harness to catch tokenizer boundary changes.

marta: Agreed. Added ticket INF-4827 to backlog and blocked rollout. :no_entry_sign:
